content.title: Public Sector And Sustainable Energy Finance
content.cta: Scroll, tab or use your keyboard to move ahead

content.text:
This chapter focuses on the critical role of public sector investments in promoting sustainable energy investments, particularly in regions with limited access to private capital. It highlights how public funds can act as a catalyst to attract private sector investments and addresses the limitations of relying solely on government resources. The chapter explores regulatory frameworks, fiscal measures and incentives, concessional finance and policy reforms as essential tools that can incentivize and enable sustainable energy investments.

This chapter examines the vital role of public sector investment in driving the global energy transition, especially in regions with limited access to private capital - a key barrier for energy transition. It highlights how public funds can catalyze private investment and not just rely solely on government resources. This chapter will focus on key areas including:
Regulatory frameworks
Fiscal incentives
Concessional finance
Policy reforms
These are all enablers that can scale sustainable energy investments.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: The Role of Public Sector in Sustainable Energy Finance
lessons.description: This lesson explores the crucial role of public sector investment in driving the renewable energy transition by providing financial support, mitigating risks, and fostering an enabling regulatory environment.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Financial Health Policies and Regulation
lessons.description: This lesson explores the importance of identifying, assessing, and mitigating financial risks in the energy sector through tools like stress testing and fiscal risk analysis.¬†

lessons.title: Lesson 3: The Energy Subsidy Reform
lessons.description: This lesson explores the economic, environmental, and fiscal implications of fossil fuel subsidies, emphasizing their role in distorting energy markets, straining public finances, and delaying sustainable energy transitions.¬†
